assumptions: The single concept image has no scale anchor; modeled meters are arbitrary proxy units used only to preserve relative proportions.
The reference uses a weak-perspective isometric presentation, approximated with a fixed orthographic comparison camera.
Five floating islands are separated in a cross-like world layout to match their screen arrangement and overlap order.
Island rear faces, exact depths, and hidden undersides are inferred from visible front and side silhouettes.
Each island underside is simplified as an inverted tapered cone; the exact rock topology is not observable.
Building and column counts are reduced and regularized into repeated proxy families rather than copied as fine detail.
The rear cloud bank around the white palace is inferred to complete the hidden silhouette and is marked with lower confidence.
No textures, small ornament, hidden interiors, high-resolution detail, or export-specific geometry are included in this approval proxy.
revision_notes: Initial reference-based blockout for silhouette and major layout approval.
